CLOSE-AS-STALE

The check transcript shows all 13 tests passing with `-W error::DeprecationWarning`, which would cause Python to promote any DeprecationWarning to an error and fail the test. Since the check passes today, the work this issue asks for — suppressing the forkpty DeprecationWarning so it doesn't dirty the test suite — is already done. A check that passes before implementation proves nothing and cannot discriminate between "work done" and "work not done."
